DeepEmberCave_Text_Npc0.en: Do not go any deeper. I mean it.
DeepEmberCave_Text_Npc0.fr: N'va pas plus profond. Je suis\nsérieux.

DeepEmberCave_Text_Npc1.en: The walls are warm. The floor is\nwarmer.
DeepEmberCave_Text_Npc1.fr: Les murs sont chauds. Le sol est\nencore plus chaud.

DeepEmberCave_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

DeepEmberCave_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
DeepEmberCave_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
